pr_title: Allowed int64 constants in ONNX parser
pr_body:
**Modified ONNX parser:**
- Removed automatic int64 to int32 conversion in ONNX parser when reading blobs.
- Added int64 to int32 conversion only for layer arguments (axis, dims, etc.) in ONNX parser.

**Modified layers:**
- Added Cast layer
- Added any type support for Permute layer
- Fixed list of supported types for Gather layer
- Fixed list of supported types for Expand layer

**Enabled Tests:**
- Enabled RAFT test

Fixes https://github.com/opencv/opencv/issues/25102

issue_context.title: New 5.x ONNX parser doesn't support int64 constants
issue_context.body:
### System Information

OpenCV 5.x with merged https://github.com/opencv/opencv/pull/24411

### Detailed description

ONNX parser always converts int64 constants and layer parameters to int32. Some models with int64 constants doesn't work with the new dnn version with int support (https://github.com/opencv/opencv/pull/24411). RAFT test is disabled because it covers this problem.

### Steps to reproduce

Enable RAFT test and run tests

### Issue submission checklist

- [X] I report the issue, it's not a question
- [X] I checked the problem with documentation, FAQ, open issues, forum.opencv.org, Stack Overflow, etc and have not found any solution
- [ ] I updated to the latest OpenCV version and the issue is still there
- [ ] There is reproducer code and related data files (videos, images, onnx, etc)
comments:
https://github.com/opencv/opencv/blob/e0b489e91774dacd5ed73a7120db291ea49441a2/modules/dnn/src/onnx/onnx_graph_simplifier.cpp#L1701-L1728

I guess, it is time to drop the int64->int casting since we now have Mat of int64 dtype in 5.x.
RAFT is enabled via https://github.com/opencv/opencv/pull/25148. This issue has been resolved.

review_comments: I think this method is not very generic

It will be used only for integer tests in this file.
test_int.cpp will contain a lot of simple tests with int operations.
Each test should have int32 and int64 versions. Each test will use randomIntMat to generate random values with int32 or int64 type with appropriate range and will use gatValueAt to check values of int32 or int64 type.
Overload `getBlob` or update the signature? e.g. `Mat getBlob(const opencv_onnx::Nodeproto& node_proto, int index, int return_dtype)`.

I think it will not look good, because the logic of the functions is different: getBlob should accept any type and return the raw blob, getIntBlob should accept only int64 or int32 types and return the blob converted to int32
Why not keep shapeMat as CV_32S?

ONNX Shape layer should return int64 values https://github.com/onnx/onnx/blob/main/docs/Operators.md#Shape
There are some tests, which fails when Shape layer returns int32 values.
